course_description: This course provides an in-depth exploration of system integration and architecture. Students will learn about the concepts and best practices for designing and integrating complex systems, including topics such as system architecture, design patterns, microservices, API design, event-driven architecture, and more. Through hands-on exercises and real-world case studies, students will have the opportunity to apply their knowledge and develop their skills in this area.

course_learning_outcomes.text: explain the fundamental concepts and principles of a system integration and architecture;
choose common system integration patterns used to solve specific integration challenges;
analyze the challenges and complexities associated with data integration and synchronization in heterogenous environments;
implement the concepts of performance tuning and optimization in system integration to achieve efficient data processing and communication;
simulate the different types od integration testing; and
demonstrate 21st century skills in all learning activities. .
